turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in class. Why?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't why I'm here. On what basis did he get a zero?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
I'm not here to be reasonable, Hale. Show me what you have.
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
No. We're not. Is there a document, or is this it?
